35dc82a3c84b4c0a8a0646d8 description: Mechanic contacted me. We found out that this C.A.S.S.I.E. system is fully automated to handle crises. Not even our adversaries are controlling it, and this could cause catastrophic problems for our operation. I've prepared a quite fun countermeasure for this, but it seems we'll need some of our opponents' equipment. Their encryption data is very useful against C.A.S.S.I.E. Assemble our device and let's move on.
35dc82a3c84b4c0a8a0646d8 successMessageT: You found their SSD? Great! We can proceed now.
a3af356391b41f8f5c97efcf: Prepare the modified flash drive with the virus to attack C.A.S.S.I.E.
10413f0d043844c6a69a88db description:
With the system virus ready, we can move forward. It seems the system operates with two passwords. The first is the general research manager's password, and we are trying to crack it and contact the scientist around the clock. The second password, C.A.S.S.I.E. sends automatically when an emergency is detected.

Place the modified flash drive with the virus in the lower server wing, then look for the main office; that might help expose the password!
10413f0d043844c6a69a88db successMessageT: Good job! Did you find the password?
b633ea5bc9821d4d48919e9d: Install the modified flash drive in the lower server block
637a389d84da48a4a34dfd17 description: It seems the administrator's room uses a fully isolated electrical system. Without power, you'll need a much more sensitive battery to deal with that reader. I sent you some blueprints to build it. Just don't forget the toolset. Enter the room and access the terminal.
637a389d84da48a4a34dfd17 successMessageT: You don't disappoint, do you? Very well done!
bfe3d1247600fce1e81b0d73: Restore power to the administration room's card reader

8e4f5535e0bf4135b8a90ec7 description: You managed to extract all the data? Great! With it, we can put an end to this sick TerraGroup experiment once and for all and prepare for any eventuality.
